<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Review the code in the workspace from the last GIT commit and provide feedback on its quality, readability, and maintainability. Highlight any potential issues or areas for improvement, such as code smells, anti-patterns, or security vulnerabilities. Additionally, suggest best practices or alternative approaches that could enhance the overall codebase.
